pretreatments.description: Electrohydrolysis pretreatment using direct current (DC) through graphite electrodes to break bonds between polymers in lignocellulose waste material, applied at 15 V for 45 min, with samples kept in 1:3 ratio of PPMS and distilled water mixture in a plastic feed tank, using a flash mixer rotating at 300 rpm, with anode and cathode placed half-immersed into the sample and DC current supplied. This pretreatment accelerates the hydrolysis stage in anaerobic digestion, increasing substrate solubilization and reducing organic matter recalcitrance for better biodegradation and biogas production.
